rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday noun for a drawn picture or artwork, rather than the activity of making it.
Use this when the drawing is a diagram, plan, chart, or other informational representation rather than an artwork.

example.english: You can understand this drawing at a glance.
example.jyutping: ni1 zoeng1 tou4 jat1 tai2 zau6 ming4

rows.note: Use this for drawing as an activity or hobby, not for the finished picture.

example.english: I loved drawing most when I was little.
example.jyutping: ngo5 sai3 go3 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 waak6 waa2
